This (a,b) pair was found via a simulated-annealing LOCAL SEARCH over the class constraints only (search/sat/tools/local_search_a25.g -- NOT a uniform random search: a direct GAP character-table computation, search/sat/tools/structure_const_a25.g, shows the class-only solution count for this exact fixed u is 82688 out of |class(2^12,1)|=7905853580625, i.e. probability ~1.05e-8 per uniform-random conjugate, so a plain random search analogous to extract_witness_n21.g needed ~1e8+ tries to expect one hit; local search converged in 16824 moves instead). It was found to ALSO be 2-transitive (an unplanned bonus: local search targeted only the class constraints, not transitivity) -- independently confirmed by scratchpad/verify_a25_witness.py (pure Python, no GAP import) via an UNBOUNDED iterate-to-fixpoint BFS over the diagonal action of {a,b,b^-1} on all 600 ordered pairs starting from (1,2): the orbit closure reached all 600 ordered pairs, with TRUE BFS diameter 43. GAP independently corroborates via a totally different computation: |<a,b>| = 7755605021665492992000000 = 25!/2 = |A_25| exactly. This fixture therefore witnesses UNCONDITIONALLY (no SAT/DRAT pipeline needed for this existence direction) that a genuine (a,b) pair of the required types generating A_25 EXISTS for this fixed u -- see the commander/Sol write-up for how this affects the priority of building the full CNF#2 2-transitivity BFS SAT encoding. Used to calibrate check_model_a25.mjs: it must ACCEPT this as a valid CNF#1 class-only model AND (in transitive/2-transitive mode) report 2-transitivity as TRUE.
